howto: Tap (or press Space or Up) to flap. The bird falls between flaps.
Fly through the gap in each pair of pipes.
Hitting a pipe, the floor or the top of the screen ends the run.
Pass the goal number of pipes (shown under the score) to win.
tips: Tap in a steady rhythm rather than in bursts.
Line up with the next gap early; the bird needs a moment to change height.
The bird tilts down as it falls: a steep nose means tap now.
Easy has wider gaps and slower pipes and a goal of 5.

controls.keyboard: Space or Up arrow to flap. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to flap. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy: wide gaps, slow pipes, goal 5. Normal: goal 10. Hard: narrow gaps, fast pipes, goal 15. Choose on the title screen.

cheats.effect: Gravity drops by 40%: the bird floats

features.one-tap-start: Tap or Space starts and flaps in one go
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the GAME OVER / YOU WIN! card
features.best-score-badge: GOAL and BEST under the big score
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: GAME OVER / YOU WIN! card with pipes passed of the goal and best
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-flappy-bird blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
